failureMessage: a secret in source ships with every clone and survives in git history forever, and an HMAC secret grants full token-MINTING power to anyone who reads it
fix: load the secret from the environment or a secret store at >= 32 random bytes (RFC 7518), and rotate the committed one

failureMessage: a token with no exp never stops being valid, and stateless validation has no revocation — a leak becomes a permanent credential
fix: set expiresIn (or an exp claim) when signing, as short as the flow allows — pair long-lived access with a refresh token, not a long expiry
